subject: Recap: procurement checks, paperwork owner, and billing start conditions
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@brightway.ai>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: procurement checks, paperwork owner, and billing start conditions

Hi Marta — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Short recap and agreed next steps so we have alignment for the trial -> paid path: 

1) Commercial path options (you flagged a preference):
   - PO (preferred by Brightway) — your procurement team typically requires a 2–3 week approval window and a standard vendor pack (W9, insurance cert, SOW).
   - Credit card (faster) — we'd go live immediately after payment setup but you mentioned org policy prefers PO for commitments > $5k/mo.
   - Marketplace (AWS Marketplace) — potential fallback if PO timeline slips; we can provide a listing summary, but this takes additional marketplace activation.

2) Trial success criteria (we proposed):
   - Usage gate: 50k tokens/day sustained over any 3 consecutive days OR 10k embeddings API calls in a 7-day window.
   - Business gate: two internal stakeholders sign-off on sample outputs (search relevance and summary quality).
   If these gates are met, we move to billing/commitment discussions.

3) Billing start: propose 2 options to choose from — (A) Billing begins on the first day after success criteria are met; or (B) Billing begins on an agreed calendar date (e.g., first of next month) even if success criteria met earlier. We can make the start conditional in the SOW.

4) Paperwork owner: you mentioned procurement will own PO issuance; please confirm contact and expected SLA. Meanwhile we attached a draft SOW and our invoice template to accelerate review.

Next steps: 
- Marta: confirm procurement POC and whether a PO or card will be used for the initial paid period (we heard PO preference).
- Marta: confirm any vendor forms needed beyond W9 and standard SOW elements.
- Redwood (Michael): provide an estimated month-one spend projection at the proposed trial configuration (tokens/day).
- Redwood (Neha): prepare marketplace summary & marketplace-as-fallback checklist.

Attachments: SOW-Brightway-draft-v1.pdf (draft SOW), redwood-invoice-template.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll follow up on the invoice template and a short budget line-item for procurement.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
work: 415-555-0123
From: Marta Lopez <marta@brightway.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Liam Foster <liam.foster@brightway.ai>, Brightway AI Procurement <procurement@brightway.ai>
Date: 2027-08-16T09:08:21-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: procurement checks, paperwork owner, and billing start conditions

Thanks Tessa — helpful recap. Quick answers: 

- Procurement POC is Liam Foster (cc'd). We will aim for PO but need to run it through our vendor intake; your 2–3 week estimate sounds right based on current backlog.
- Required docs: W9, insurance cert, signed SOW — procurement will send a vendor packet request in their intake email (they sometimes require financial contacts for invoice routing).
- Marketplace is of interest as an alternate payroll-free route; please include the listing summary as you mentioned.

Can you also provide: 
- A simple, line-item estimate for month-one spend assuming the trial success gates are met (we want a number to include in the JIRA intake ticket).
- A sample invoice showing payment terms (net30) so our AP team can validate routing.

Appreciate the speed here.

—Marta
Marta Lopez
Head of Partnerships | Brightway AI
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@brightway.ai>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: procurement checks, paperwork owner, and billing start conditions

Thanks Marta — looping in answers and delivering the two items you asked for. Forwarding the attachments again and quick notes inline.

On PO timing: correct, 2–3 weeks is our typical experience. If you need a faster ramp we can accept initial payment by card and convert to PO billing for the committed period once the PO is issued.

Attached: redwood-invoice-template.xlsx (sample invoice, net30 shown) and a short month-one estimate table (line items: base tokens, embeddings, burst buffer). For planning assume~$6.4k/mo if trial triggers billing at the proposed thresholds (I'll attach the estimate sheet to procurement ticket).

Billing start proposal: we can do this either of two ways —
A) Performance-triggered: we start billing the day after the success criteria are met (preferred for tight trials).
B) Fixed-date: you pick a calendar start (e.g., 2027-09-01) and we begin billing then even if success criteria complete earlier.

Marketplace fallback: Neha has the one-pager and timeline (typically 4–6 weeks to publish). Neha — please add the marketplace summary to the shared Drive folder and note any action items for Brightway to enable listing.

Next: Liam — if you can open a vendor ticket with procurement and share required intake fields, we’ll populate them immediately (vendor tax info, AP contact).

Links: SOW draft (Drive) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_sow
DocuSign SOW template: https://app.docusign.com/templates/REDWOOD-SOW-2027

Thanks — I’ll flag this for our legal and finance teams if procurement needs any non-standard clauses.

Best,
Tessa
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: action items from Brightway thread (DW-8421)

Internal note for the team — summary of quick actions so we don't miss the procurement window: 

- Michael: please produce a 1-page cost breakdown for month-one (assume token profile: 50k/day sustained for 7 days). Include base, embeddings, and burst. Use conservative rounding; procurement wants a single-line figure for JIRA. (Due EOD 8/17)
- Neha: upload the marketplace one-pager and the marketplace-as-fallback checklist to the Drive folder linked in-thread. Also outline what permissions Brightway would need to accept a marketplace invoice. (Due EOD 8/18)
- Tessa: follow up with Liam once procurement intake is opened and send the W9 + insurance cert request.

Attach the invoice template and SOW draft to the procurement ticket once Liam confirms intake.

Thanks — short and concrete so we can move the PO in the next 2–3 weeks.

Tessa
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
